name: Milky Way
description: A hazy band of starlight lies across the sheet from corner to corner, crowded with bright four-point glints that dwindle to specks away from it.

code.style: --rule: ( --w: @calc(max(0, 1 - abs(((@x - 0.5) / @X) + ((@y - 0.5) / @Y) - 1 + @rn(-0.18, 0.18)) / 1.414 / 0.26)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -55%; background: var(--color1); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, #000, transparent); opacity: calc(0.42 * @var(--w)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 58.0% 42.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 58.0% 58.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 42.0% 58.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 42.0% 42.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 58.0% 42.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 58.0% 58.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 42.0% 58.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 42.0% 42.0%); transform: translate(@r(-22%, 22%), @r(-22%, 22%)) scale(calc(0.12 + 0.8 * @var(--w) * @r(0.35, 1))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } background: radial-gradient(circle at @r(8, 92)% @r(8, 92)%, var(--color2) 0 1.4%, transparent 2.2%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
